rows.observations: Thus, the accuracy and fairness of the GSIS account balance as of year-end cannot be ascertained. The gaps in procedures and policies expose the City and its employees to unnecessary interest and affect the employees' loan privileges and other benefits from the GSIS.
rows.recommendations: b. Require the CPO to: • Require the AAOs to ensure that monthl amortizations shall be deducted from the monthly salaries of employees; • Maintain a detailed and comprehensiv database of all employees with existing loan accounts and mismatched records with the GS1S for monitoring and reconciliation purposes; and • Regularly coordinate with the DPOs, AAOs, an OCAT to address the root cause and mitigate the discrepancies/deficiencies noted. c.Require the OCAT to: • Address and correct the accounting errors note in paragraph 3(a); and • Expedite, together with DPOs, AAOs, and CPC the reconciliation of members' records with the GSIS to avoid the discrepancies/deficiencies noted.
